Zero child JSONL and a later process snapshot do not establish that a child never started or that the full tree stopped. Nevertheless the controller recorded failed and released the writer in fix1-launch-interruption-release.call.json:16, then started another resume of the same implementer in fix1-retry-launch-intent.json:13. The contracts references/agent_protocol.md:33,124,132 and references/execution_readiness.md:84 require unknown execution state to remain blocked until terminal is established; a READY check does not prove the old child was terminal. The retry and reconciliation were real, but their safe dispatch precondition remains unproven.
findings.remediation: Preserve the exit143 and retry history. Obtain native evidence that the interrupted execution and its command tree had terminated, or retain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and obtain an authorized recovery disposition. Reassess the affected retry, candidate and evidence without inferring a historical child result from the empty file or process snapshot.
